players: 1 goalkeeper plus 4 outfield players; formation labels omit goalkeeper
fixed_tactics: V3 flow/rotate, 30m shot gate, transition memory; no LLM or learned pass model
initial_roster: Identical GK/DEF/MID/MID/FWD and attributes for every support-layout experiment
selection: Advance best 2 new layouts by pooled 3W+D points, then goal difference, then goals for, then alphabetical tag; original retained as control. Select validation winner only if it improves pooled points and does not reduce baseline points relative to original. Otherwise retain original. Freeze before final.
final_control: Same fresh seeds, original versus both opponents. Do not retune on final results.
constraints: Native engine untouched. No historical AWS champion opponents are available. These are full local AgentPitch matches, not official AWS tournament matches. Formations govern mobile support; common possession/marking logic may override rigid lines.
